content:
[Goal]

- Please add "... average ASCII code (rounded down) of all lowercase ..." to the problem description.

[Input]

- I agree with @nicof6786's suggestion, but please move the line "[[s]] contains only letters" into the Constraints section instead.

- Please consider adding the length of string s as part of the input; e.g.:

5
nNeoc

This will help players who code in languages which do not automatically support parsing of variable-length inputs, especially in Reverse mode.

[Cases]

- Consider adding one or two more non-trivial cases and then reordering the cases, such that the solution is not immediately obvious in Reverse mode.

Thank you!

✅ Approved the contribution.
Comment: Interesting as a shortest or reverse, probably less as a fastest.

Input
Suggestion: specify that input contains only letters

Output
Suggestion: specify that output must be `0` when there is no lower case letters

Thanks

Output
* Please change ". If decimal, it should be floored" to "rounded down".

Constraints
* Please change "<" to "≤".

* Please change "[[s]]" to "length of [[s]]".

Stub generator
* Please add a write statement, e.g. write answer.

Cases
* Please add more pairs of cases to ensure that every letter appears in both lowercase and uppercase in at least one test and at least one validator.

* Please add a pair of cases where [[s]] contains no lowercase letters.

Thanks.
Thanks a lot for your feedback 😊

Thank you for your feeback 🙏🏻. 
Done ✅
